coverage.reason: Door library is static3.28m wide/2.62m high with open-leaf sweep; existing functional doors/garage port geometry do not match. No decorative second door, behavior change or blocked door port.

Asset landing rises1.5m, while live ground-floor thresholds are0.2m over terrain; placing it at an entry breaks step/door contracts. It needs a deliberately redesigned stair entrance, outside furnishing scope.
3.5m high asset cannot replace4m railcar or3.6m derailed opaque proxy honestly. No remaining canonical wagon host; adding another wagon would block rail/service corridor or require a new siding.
H01 is4×4×5m closed proxy; finished platform including approach is4.06×8.23m and only3/4.1m high. Unit-scale use would consume protected ridge access and mismatch sealed physics.
H02 is6×5×2.7m closed proxy; finished closed shell is6.3×5.38×2.7m. Replacing a continuous opaque box with aperture geometry requires explicit shot/LOS/closed-access fit, so retain it.

No existing shelter footprint exists in the fixed hills building catalogue. Adding4.3×3.3m shelter would be a new building and cover landmark; keep finished source available for a later authored-layout decision.

A06 warehouse opening is6m wide×4m high; completed barn-door frame is5.45×3m. Unit-scale frame would narrow the verified entrance and leave unexplained gaps. Preserve original open portal, no door mechanics.

Existing F03 is3×3×4.5m sealed opaque proxy. Enclosed finished stand is2.2×3.011×4.6m with open legs/ladder; hiding its solid box creates invisible obstruction, while a second stand is an unapproved landmark.

Existing B07/B08 are4×4×8m sealed opaque proxies; platform is4.06×4.06×4.1m and roof extends to5.8m. Unit-scale assembly cannot hide those proxies without invisible solid upper volume or changed silhouette.
Existing authored rail is a continuous single line, with no matching branching track. Switch lever is not placed as unexplained debris and does not authorize track geometry changes.
Source frame is 2.8×3.2×.8m, while B04 lintel/clear opening are already fixed at 1.2×2.4m. Aperture and lintel contact must be native-fitted before replacing trim.
Source gate is 8.8m wide; canonical compound gate is exactly6m. Unit-scale assembly cannot replace the protected gate and must not close its pedestrian/vehicle access.

Existing B04 door is 1.2×2.4m. Source closed assembly is 1.44×2.556m and open leaf has 1.56m depth; neither clearance nor leaf sweep is certified. Keep current doorway and no functional-door mechanics.
4.28m width/3.75m height frame is not compatible with the current warehouse/garage aperture and lintel. Retrofitting or layering it over the functional opening would change access and door behavior.
P04 rail is through-running at both map edges; there is no siding terminus to support a buffer stop. Blocking the live rail/service route for catalogue coverage is unjustified.
